Projects

Systems I have built.

Major project

Tethered Powered Drone System for Continuous Agricultural Monitoring

  • Designed the power delivery and tether system and demonstrated 50 minutes of continuous flight.
  • Built the quadcopter on a Pixhawk flight controller and added a camera with a 2.4 GHz wireless video link for live viewing on a ground monitor.
  • Built an operator-controlled sprayer. The operator watches the live video and sends the sprayer direction over LoRa to the onboard ESP32, which drives the servo.

Spray control path

  1. OnboardCamera
  2. 2.4 GHz linkGround monitor
  3. OperatorSends direction
  4. LoRaOnboard ESP32
  5. OutputServo sprayer

NAIN Karnataka incubated · ₹4 lakh grant · Apr 2026 · Embedded Lead

MEDCONNEC+: Smart Health Monitoring Jacket

  • Integrated five biomedical sensors into a wearable jacket.
  • Designed a dual ESP32 DevKit architecture that splits the sensor load across two boards, and built the Blynk IoT dashboard for live health data on mobile.
  • Engineered low-power sensor interface hardware and battery power management for wearable use.
  • Presented the working prototype at the NAIN Innovation Conclave 2026, IIIT-Bangalore.

  2. Controllers2 × ESP32 DevKit
  3. CloudBlynk IoT
  4. DisplayMobile dashboard

Arduino Uno · Ultrasonic sensors

Autonomous Car

An autonomous mobile robot with obstacle detection and navigation driven by real-time sensor input, with the sensors and motor-driver circuitry integrated for autonomous movement.

Arduino Uno · Distance sensing

Blind Aid Stick

A compact, low-cost assistive navigation prototype built around an Arduino Uno and HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor. The sensor measures the distance to obstacles ahead; an active buzzer provides an audible warning as an obstacle approaches. The circuit uses the HC-SR04 TRIG pin on D9, ECHO on D10 and buzzer signal on D8.
